title: lem-sc-p1-tor-kernel-boundary-exact
statement: Let R be a commutative ring and M an R-module. For every surjective R-linear map q:F → N, there is an R-linear map δ_q : Tor₁^R(N,M) → ker(q) ⊗_R M, and the pairs (Tor₁(q,M), δ_q) and (δ_q, ker(q) inclusion ⊗ 1_M) are exact.

source.place: Section 00LY, Tags 00M0 (Tor exact sequence), 00LZ (resolution functoriality), 00M3 (Tor symmetry); https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00LY

proof.text: Construct the boundary map for each surjection from the connecting morphism of a degreewise split short exact sequence of free resolutions, transported through the Tor and tensor augmentation identifications. The homology long exact sequence gives both exactness assertions.

theorem exists_tor_kernel_boundary_exact
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) :
    ∃ δ : ∀ (F N : ModuleCat.{u} R) (q : F →ₗ[R] N),
        Function.Surjective q →
          (((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} R) 1).obj N).obj M) →ₗ[R]
            (LinearMap.ker q ⊗[R] M),
      ∀ (F N : ModuleCat.{u} R) (q : F →ₗ[R] N) (hq : Function.Surjective q),
        Function.Exact (((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} R) 1).map
          (ModuleCat.ofHom q)).app M).hom (δ F N q hq) ∧
        Function.Exact (δ F N q hq) ((LinearMap.ker q).subtype.rTensor M)
